decision: bounded read-only status reconciliation after ambiguous synthetic workload stop

reviews.correctness: A stop transport failure is ambiguous: the worker may already have persisted stopped state. Re-sending start is unsafe; status must prove a terminal state.
reviews.robustness_security: Use only the existing bounded qrexec service with a read-only status action. Never signal recorded PIDs and never weaken duration bounds. Fail closed if terminal state cannot be proven.
reviews.latency_resources_regression: Fast path adds zero calls when stop returns stopped/not-running/completed. Failure path adds at most 3 read-only probes with bounded delay; no daemon, database, listener, or MissionQueue changes.

alternatives.name: trust stop attempt
alternatives.rejected: cannot prove remote cleanup after timeout or lost response

alternatives.name: repeat stop only
alternatives.rejected: idempotent but still cannot distinguish repeated transport loss from confirmed cleanup

alternatives.name: persistent workload-control daemon
alternatives.rejected: adds lifecycle, memory, credential and attack-surface cost before Qubes qualification

qa: status is read-only and reports running/stopped/not-running
acknowledged terminal stop uses no extra probe
lost stop response reconciles through status
bounded probes fail closed while status remains running
partial start rollback reports both start failure and unresolved cleanup
lesson: Distributed cleanup needs positive terminal evidence; an attempted stop is not equivalent to confirmed remote cleanup.
